title: ZAMEENE GARM PA LAASHA PADA HAI AKBAR KA
body:
Salaam Rukhsate aakhir Hussain tak pohncha
Hai sakht aalame ghurbat meLaal Zehra ka
Koi nahi'n jo bataaye ke hai kaha'n Laasha
Hussain dhoond rahe hain Pisarnahi'n milta
<<MINI>>
Zameene garm pa Laasha pada hai Akbar ka
<<DIVIDER>>
Zaeef Baap ki nazre'n Jawaan ka Laasha
Hai Gham se surkh Hussaine ghareeb ka chehra
Sirhaane baith ke paiham ye de rahe hain sada
Hussain Aaya Hai milne jawaab do Beta
<<MINI>>
Zameene garm pa Laasha pada hai Akbar ka
<<DIVIDER>>
Hai khaimagaah me har simt hashr ka saamaa'n
Shabeehe Husne Payambar tha Akbare Zeesha'n
Bahan ke dil me tha Bhai ke byaah ka armaa'n
Sakina kehti hai Bhayya kahan gaye Amma
<<MINI>>
Zameene garm pa Laasha pada hai Akbar ka
<<DIVIDER>>
Khuda hiJaane ke Shabbir kitne hain be aas
Na koi Bhai na Beta hai ab Ghareeb ke paas
Shadeed dhoop me reh reh ke badh rahi hai pyaas
Hussain kitne hain tanha bichhad gaye Abbas
<<MINI>>
Zameene garm pa Laasha pada hai Akbar ka
<<DIVIDER>>
Kaleja dekh ke Bete ka dil tadapta tha
Hussain dekhte the aur ghar ujadta tha
Tha aftaab falak pa abhi ujala tha
Magar Hussain ki aankhon me bas andhera tha
<<MINI>>
Zameene garm pa Laasha pada hai Akbar ka
<<DIVIDER>>
Qadam Hussain ke Akhtar zamana choomega
Maqaame arsh pa dekhegi sabr ko duniya
Rahega lab pa fazaaon ke har ghadi Nouha
Hussain uthaaenge LaashaJawaan Bete ka
<<MINI>>
Zameene garm pa Laasha pada hai Akbar ka
author: Akhtar Zaidi
